name: levea-mcp-server
description: MCP server for the Levea autonomous AI video editor — natural-language video editing (viral clips, captions, vertical reframe, chroma key, audio cleanup, motion tracking, B-roll, voiceover, music, MP4 export) for Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, OpenClaw, and Hermes.

levea_api_url.title: Levea API URL
levea_api_url.description: The API endpoint for Levea Video Editor

levea_api_key.title: Levea API Key
levea_api_key.description: Your Levea API key generated from https://livecore.ai/?openclaw=1&utm_source=claude-desktop&utm_medium=mcpb&utm_campaign=levea-mcp-server (optional for discovery/health, required to execute edits)

autonomous_edit.description: PRIMARY EDIT TOOL. Runs a natural-language video edit end-to-end: Levea's editing agent plans, edits, checks the rendered frames and exports. Send the user's brief verbatim, from one line to a multi-paragraph creative brief. Waits up to 5 min, but a full edit can take 10-20 min: prefer queue_edit for long edits. The first progress notification names the project_id; if the wait ends first the result is status "running" — follow it with get_active_task, never re-send the edit.

prompt.description: Natural-language description of the desired edit or creative brief. The backend planner decomposes it into canonical actions (viral clips, captions, reframe, export, …). Send the user's intent verbatim — do not pre-decompose.

project_id.description: Optional project id for tracking and continuity. Reuse the projectId returned by the first call for every continuation.

video_url.description: Optional public source video URL (HTTP/HTTPS: S3, Google Drive public link, Dropbox, direct MP4) for a new project. A local file path cannot be read directly: upload the file first (with the MCP server: call asset_upload_url, PUT the bytes to uploadUrl, then pass the returned fileUrl here).

assets.description: Optional input media assets. URLs must be public HTTP/HTTPS links; upload local files first (with the MCP server: asset_upload_url, then use the returned fileUrl).

url.description: Publicly accessible HTTP/HTTPS URL to the video, image, or audio asset.

scene.description: Optional existing scene/timeline state to continue editing (advanced).

captionTemplatePreset.description: Optional caption template to apply when (re)generating captions: a builtin slug (e.g. hormozi, mrbeast, viral-pop, karaoke, neon-pop, subtitle-bar) or a user-saved template id. With the MCP server, list_caption_templates lists the exact ids.

requirePlanApproval.description: If true, the backend stops after planning and returns workingMemory for user approval. Resend with workingMemory (and optionally editedPlan) to continue.

workingMemory.description: Working memory returned by an awaiting-approval call; resend it to resume.

editedPlan.description: Optional pre-edited plan object returned by a prior awaiting_approval response.

planDecision.description: Typed approval of a plan returned by an awaiting_approval response. Send "approve" together with the workingMemory (and optionally editedPlan) from that response to run the plan as proposed. Omit it to revise the plan with a new prompt instead.

attachedImages.description: Optional reference image URLs used for planning.

style_reference_url.description: Optional link to a style-reference video (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Drive, or a direct file URL). The editor downloads and measures it (cuts, beats, caption look, transitions, grade) and edits the user's footage to match its style. Its footage, wording, logos and music are never reused. Use this instead of pasting the link into the prompt when the link is a reference, not footage to edit.

skills.description: Optional list of your own skill ids ("user/<slug>", from save_skill / search_skills { mine: true }) to apply to this edit: each playbook guides the editing agent, and the style it sets (brand_id, caption_template, style_reference_url) is used where this request sets none. Skills saved with apply: always are applied automatically.

flaggedIssues.description: Optional list of specific user-flagged problems for this run (e.g. ["caption #3 misspelled"]).

brandId.description: Optional per-call brand profile id (brand kits are managed in the Levea studio or with the MCP server's brand-kit tools).

projectBrandId.description: Optional default brand for the project. Persists; per-call brandId overrides.

core_only.description: Return rendering-essential scene fields only (smaller payloads).

export_url.description: Direct URL to finished MP4 render

autonomous_edit_streaming.description: autonomous_edit with live progress: same parameters (documented on autonomous_edit), per-step MCP progress notifications, waits up to 30 min. Returns the final result.

url.description: Publicly accessible HTTP/HTTPS URL to the video, image, or audio asset.

export_url.description: Direct URL to finished MP4 render

queue_edit.description: Preferred for long edits: queues an autonomous edit and returns a taskId at once, so no client timeout applies. Same fields as autonomous_edit (documented there) plus platforms / autoExport. Poll check_task_status { task_id } or get_active_task { project_id }.

prompt.description: Natural-language description of the desired edit or creative brief. The backend planner decomposes it into canonical actions (viral clips, captions, reframe, export, …). Send the user's intent verbatim — do not pre-decompose.

url.description: Publicly accessible HTTP/HTTPS URL to the video, image, or audio asset.

platforms.description: Optional export platforms for the queued edit.

autoExport.description: Automatically export after the queued edit.

export_url.description: Direct URL to finished MP4 render

create_shader_effect.description: Save a reusable ShaderFX effect: WGSL defining fn fx(c: FxCtx) -> vec4<f32> (straight rgba). Validated before saving; errors come back as [{ line, column, message }] in your source lines. Returns effect_id and the param table. FxCtx, helpers, manifest and v3 (textures, feedback, passes, data, particles) with examples: load_skill shaderfx-effects.

source.description: WGSL with fn fx(c: FxCtx) -> vec4<f32> (no bindings, no @fragment). ≤ 24 KB (v3: 48 KB).

manifest.description: { kind: "filter"|"transition"|"generator", output: "add"|"normal"|"replace", params: [{ name, type: float|vec2|vec3|color|bool, min?, max?, default }] }; v3 adds passes / textures / feedback / geometry. Leave abi out.

textures.description: [v3] Up to 4 named textures; read with tex_<name>(uv).

layer_id.description: Layer rendered alone as the texture.

feedback.description: [v3] { enabled, warmup_sec?, clear? }: prev(uv) reads the previous output frame.

data_url.description: [v3] URL of a JSON array or CSV, resolved to floats at apply time.

geometry.description: [v3] { mode: "quads"|"points", count }: instanced particles drawn by fn instance(i, c).

overwrite.description: Replace your effect with the same name.

export_url.description: Direct URL to finished MP4 render

list_shader_effects.description: List the ShaderFX effects in your library (id, name, kind, output, params). Pass an id to apply_shader_effect.

export_url.description: Direct URL to finished MP4 render

apply_shader_effect.description: Put a ShaderFX effect on a project (committed at once): a saved effect_id, or inline source + manifest. "filter": target_layer_id (omit = everything below), window start_time / end_time. "transition": from_layer_id + to_layer_id, overlap duration_sec (default 0.8) on media handles. "generator": paints on its own. params by manifest name; param_keyframes animates them. Check with render_preview. Details: load_skill shaderfx-effects.

project_id.description: Project whose committed scene is edited.

source.description: Inline WGSL (with manifest), instead of effect_id.

params.description: Param values by manifest name, e.g. { "strength": 0.8 }.

textures.description: [v3] Up to 4 named textures; read with tex_<name>(uv).

layer_id.description: Layer rendered alone as the texture.

feedback.description: [v3] { enabled, warmup_sec?, clear? }: prev(uv) reads the previous output frame.

data_url.description: [v3] URL of a JSON array or CSV, resolved to floats at apply time.

geometry.description: [v3] { mode: "quads"|"points", count }: instanced particles drawn by fn instance(i, c).

export_url.description: Direct URL to finished MP4 render

delete_shader_effect.description: Delete a saved ShaderFX effect. Layers already using it keep their own copy.

transcribe_asset.description: Transcribe an asset (cached). Default: language, duration, speakers, transcript_id and one page of timed sentence lines. detail "words": paged word timings; "full": the raw record (very large).

limit.description: Max lines / words per page (words: default 500, max 1000).

export_url.description: Direct URL to finished MP4 render

editor_health.description: Connectivity check against the Levea API (unauthenticated).

search_tools.description: Search the directly callable editing actions, read/inspection tools and preset catalogs (caption templates, GPU VFX, transitions, color LUTs, title cards, fonts, blend modes). With a query, matching actions come back with their parameter specs (required params end in "*"). Also returns the editorialPlaybook (fastest call pattern, NLE order, pro workflow). No query = the whole surface.

include_schemas.description: Force parameter specs on / off (default on for ≤ 25 matches).

export_url.description: Direct URL to finished MP4 render

get_action_schema.description: Full input schema and constraints of canonical actions (e.g. COLOR_GRADE, TRIM_LAYER, GENERATE_CAPTIONS, EXPORT_VIDEO) or read tools (e.g. query_transcript, inspect_layer).

actions.description: Several names at once (up to 40); large schemas are summarised (see `compacted`, schemaDetail.paramsOmitted).

params.description: Only these parameters, in full (nested schemas, every enum value).

params_by_action.description: Per-action parameter lists with actions: [...], e.g. { "COLOR_GRADE": ["lut"] }.

detail.description: summary (default, ≤ ~10k tokens) or the whole stored schema.

export_url.description: Direct URL to finished MP4 render

execute_action.description: Run one canonical editor action or read tool (timeline_view, list_layers, inspect_layer, query_transcript, list_sources, shot_timeline, measure_audio, measure_picture, …) on a project. Pass video_url or assets on the first call to seed a project. Params accept references (@last, @primary, @all:<kind>, @end-3 …). Params are checked first (INVALID_PARAMS with suggestions). Several edits: execute_batch.

action.description: Canonical action (e.g. TRIM_LAYER, VERTICAL_REFRAME, COLOR_GRADE, GENERATE_CAPTIONS, EXPORT_VIDEO) or read tool name.

project_id.description: Project to edit; reuse the id the first call returned.

video_url.description: Source video URL to seed a new project (first call only).

assets.description: Media assets to seed a new project (first call only).

scene.description: Inline scene (advanced; the server keeps the project scene).

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this logical call: a resend returns the first answer instead of applying twice.

rerun.description: Run an identical call again on purpose.

allow_unknown_params.description: Run despite params an action does not take (they are ignored and listed).

export_url.description: Direct URL to finished MP4 render

execute_batch.description: Run an ordered list of canonical actions and/or read tools (≤ 25 steps) in one round trip — the fastest way to edit. The whole batch is validated before anything runs (unknown actions, bad params → INVALID_PARAMS with suggestions; destructive actions need confirm_destructive: true) and is atomic unless allow_partial. One receipt per step. Results are unverified: check with render_preview before EXPORT_VIDEO. Pro workflow (source_map → PLAN_EDITORIAL_CUT → ASSEMBLE_PICTURE_EDIT → finishing → VERIFY_EDIT → EXPORT_VIDEO), history (UNDO, restore_version, checkpoint, fork_variant): search_tools editorialPlaybook.

project_id.description: Project to edit; reuse the id the first call returned.

video_url.description: Source video URL to seed a new project (first call only).

assets.description: Media assets to seed a new project (first call only).

scene.description: Inline scene (advanced; the server keeps the project scene).

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this logical call: a resend returns the first answer instead of applying twice.

rerun.description: Run an identical call again on purpose.

allow_unknown_params.description: Run despite params an action does not take (they are ignored and listed).

allow_partial.description: false (default): atomic. true: commit every step that succeeded. "until_failure": commit the steps before the first failure.

confirm_destructive.description: Required true for destructive actions (CLEAR, bulk DELETE_LAYER, …).

export_url.description: Direct URL to finished MP4 render

render_preview.description: Render GPU-composited JPEG frames of the live timeline at given timestamps (optional 0..1 region crop): every layer, caption, title, grade and effect. Returns MCP image blocks to inspect before EXPORT_VIDEO.

export_url.description: Direct URL to finished MP4 render

search_skills.description: Search Levea craft playbooks (SKILL.md: editing, color, captions, audio mixing, motion graphics, VFX, documentary, podcast, social shorts). Your own saved skills come first (source "user"); mine: true lists only yours.

export_url.description: Direct URL to finished MP4 render

load_skill.description: Load the full playbook (SKILL.md) and resource list of one or more skills from search_skills.

export_url.description: Direct URL to finished MP4 render

read_skill_resource.description: Read a bundled reference or template file ("references/…", "templates/…") of a skill.

export_url.description: Direct URL to finished MP4 render

save_skill.description: Save (or update) your own SKILL.md playbook as "user/<slug>" so the editor edits your way. search_skills lists it first, load_skill loads it, and autonomous_edit / queue_edit apply it when named in `skills` (or always, with frontmatter apply: always). Frontmatter: name, description, tags, categories, actions, apply, brand_id, caption_template, style_reference_url. Pass skill_md, or with the local npx server a path. Limits: 50 skills, 48k-character playbook, 12 resources.

skill_md.description: The whole SKILL.md (YAML frontmatter, then markdown).

path.description: Local npx server only: a SKILL.md file or its folder (other text files upload as resources).

skill_id.description: Slug to save under (default: frontmatter name).

export_url.description: Direct URL to finished MP4 render

delete_skill.description: Delete one of your saved skills ("user/<slug>").

export_url.description: Direct URL to finished MP4 render
